def get_all_messages(phone_number):
    all_msgs = []
    page = 0
    while True:
        msgs = apis.phone.search_text_messages(
            access_token=phone_token,
            phone_number=phone_number,
            page_index=page,
            page_limit=20,
            sort_by='-created_at'
        )
        all_msgs.extend(msgs)
        if len(msgs) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    return all_msgs
